title: Coefficient-four log^11 loglog^9 construction with shared hash multipliers

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total language evaluated by family.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine; N<128 outputs0 and every larger header/data string follows the exact guarded program. Let L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),actual L-bit header S-1. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z^2),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^3),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^5),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^5),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^7),k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^9). Initial A1 D11,precisionceil(L/28)+10,exact rational reconstruction field,checked seed<=5L. B1 uses its supplied adaptive block/field allocation. Initial122 field-element data plus B5 modulus and header are charged in P; all five internal maps have zero data. Four B2.2 maps use t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t,K=128rho*M,blockB=E+ceil(log2 M)+10,degree s=P2(8*(B+ceil(log2 nprime))),y-row sizea=s,universeceil(2a^2/t)+a,one independent shared multiplier z and exact K*B>=4rho*s*M guard. The complete seed is PVseed,z,U. Short E1 is direct B2.3. Index alphabet2 and d0 rounds are separate from independence h. Layout delta1/125,m=floor(r/125),w=ceil(log2 r),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^2/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. B5 degree1000w,prefix250w,blocks750w,one shared NW multiplier,y-row sizea=s,universe5a^2+a,CEweight5/4; seed is independent prefix(y0,z0),sharedz,U. Its only data is the modulus. All designs are computed by exact CE. Fixed good S0 is only a charged hardness restriction; the total polynomial-time program handles every header. Eventual d0<4L,P<20L and badfraction2N^(-1/28) versus S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) give the supplied all-length bound.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^9. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(9+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=20L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact checks of the actual merged evaluator, scalar extraction plans, fixed-seed linearity, multi-bit hash collision distributions, weak-design conditional expectations and block truncation, field towers/PV maps, header and zero-data offsets, refreshed index mocks, robust-function arithmetic and full-B2 local sharing patterns. Obsolete optional gate-lemma and extractor-tree fixtures are omitted. These checks do not establish the universal theorem or instantiate the eventual enormous family.
